benefit: Onion volatiles disrupt host-finding by carrot rust fly. Carrot foliage in turn masks onions from onion fly. Plant alternating rows or as alternating bands to maintain canopy density of both.

members.title: Alternating onion and carrot rows
members.body: Plant onions and carrots in alternating rows or 2-row bands. Maintain through harvest; do not pull onions too early or carrot fly protection drops.
